caption: The browser keeps only the ID abc123; user Anu and the ₹750 cart stay in the server-side store. Notice that the Set-Cookie header in step 3 and the Cookie header sent back in step 4 carry the same ID, and that after Max-Age 1800 the cookie is gone while the ₹750 survives until garbage collection.

spec.aria: Anu logs in, the server creates session abc123 and saves user Anu and cart_total 750 in the store, sends Set-Cookie PHPSESSID=abc123 with Max-Age=1800, the browser later sends Cookie PHPSESSID=abc123 with GET /cart and gets back HTML with the ₹750 cart, and after 1800 seconds the cookie is gone so the next visit starts an empty session.
